:L_412
:L_411
ADD_VAL_TO_INT_LVAR 30@ 1
IF 0
IS_NUMBER_GREATER_THAN_INT_LVAR 6 30@
GOTO_IF_FALSE @L_413
GOTO @EX_ACTORS
:L_413
FREE_MEMORY 14@
CLEAR_CHAR_TASKS 0@
RESTORE_CAMERA_JUMPCUT
SET_CAMERA_BEHIND_PLAYER
DISPLAY_HUD 1
DISPLAY_RADAR 1
USE_TEXT_COMMANDS 0
SET_CHAR_PROOFS 0@ 0 0 0 0 0
SET_EVERYONE_IGNORE_PLAYER 0 0
SET_PLAYER_CONTROL 0 1
#ifdef CSA
GOTO @ACTIVATE
#else
TERMINATE_THIS_SCRIPT
#endif
